{"command": "python3 -c "
import cv2, numpy as np

# In obs_0052:
# pos = (-0.3536, 4.8606), heading = 180 (facing -y)
# In view:
# Floor lamp on left: col ~ 10..130
# Potted plant 1 on bottom-left: pot at col ~ 0..100, y > 400
# Cabinet 1 on right: col ~ 370..490, y ~ 300..370
img52 = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0052.png')

# 1. Cabinet 1 in obs 52:
# Base of cabinet 1:
for c in [400, 440, 480]:
    for y in range(350, 400):
        if img52[y, c, 0] > 140 and img52[y, c, 1] > 150: # floor
            print(f'Cabinet col {c} bottom at y={y-1}')
            break

# 2. Floor lamp in obs 52:
lamp_mask = (img52[:,:,0] > 70) & (img52[:,:,0] < 100) & (img52[:,:,1] > 70) & (img52[:,:,1] < 95) & (img52[:,:,2] > 70) & (img52[:,:,2] < 95)
ys, xs = np.where(lamp_mask & (np.arange(512)[None, :] < 150))
print('Lamp base in obs 52 xs:', xs.min(), xs.max(), 'ys:', ys.min(), ys.max())
contact_y_lamp = ys.max()
center_x_lamp = (xs.min() + xs.max()) / 2.0
f, h, cy, cx = 256.0, 1.55, 255.5, 255.5
d_lamp = f * h / (contact_y_lamp - cy)
dx_lamp = (center_x_lamp - cx) * d_lamp / f
# heading 180: world_x = cam_x - dx, world_y = cam_y - d
lamp_x = -0.3536 - dx_lamp
lamp_y = 4.8606 - d_lamp
print(f'Lamp from obs 52: d={d_lamp:.3f}, dx={dx_lamp:.3f} -> x={lamp_x:.3f}, y={lamp_y:.3f}')

# 3. Plant 1 pot in obs 52:
pot_mask = (img52[:,:,2] > 140) & (img52[:,:,0] < 80) & (img52[:,:,1] < 100)
pys, pxs = np.where(pot_mask)
print('Plant 1 in obs 52 pot xs:', pxs.min(), pxs.max(), 'ys:', pys.min(), pys.max())
contact_y_p = pys.max()
center_x_p = (pxs.min() + pxs.max()) / 2.0
d_p = f * h / (contact_y_p - cy)
dx_p = (center_x_p - cx) * d_p / f
plant1_x = -0.3536 - dx_p
plant1_y = 4.8606 - d_p
print(f'Plant 1 from obs 52: d={d_p:.3f}, dx={dx_p:.3f} -> x={plant1_x:.3f}, y={plant1_y:.3f}')
"", "description": "Measure cabinet 1, lamp, plant 1 in obs 52"}
